title: IU KPMP & HuBMAP Visium HD Protocol
author: Ricardo Melo Ferreira

steps.title: Prepare FFPE blocks
steps.instruction: Prepare FFPE blocks following the 10X Visium HD FFPE Tissue Preparation Handbook (https://cdn.10xgenomics.com/image/upload/v1756507543/support-documents/CG000684_VisiumHDFFPETissuePrepHandbook_RevD.pdf).

steps.title: Prepare library
steps.instruction: Prepare the library following the 10X Visium HD Gene Expression User Guide (https://cdn.10xgenomics.com/image/upload/v1756507345/support-documents/CG000685_VisiumHD_GeneExpression_UserGuide_RevD.pdf).
